title: Time Clauses: When and As soon as
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ahora sabes cómo estructurar cláusulas de tiempo para coordinar acciones futuras en el entorno laboral.

stages.title: Concepto Teórico: Time Clauses (When / As soon as)

parts.visual: Usamos When (cuando) y As soon as (tan pronto como) para conectar dos eventos futuros. REGLA: Después de 'when' o 'as soon as', usamos el PRESENTE SIMPLE, no el futuro.
parts.audio: We use When and As soon as to connect two future events. RULE: After when or as soon as, we use the PRESENT SIMPLE, not the future tense.

parts.visual: Ejemplo correcto: I will call you when I arrive (Te llamaré cuando llegue). Incorrecto: ...when I will arrive. Ejemplo: As soon as we receive the payment, we will send the goods.
parts.audio: Correct: I will call you when I arrive. Incorrect: when I will arrive. Another example: As soon as we receive the payment, we will send the goods.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del verbo para la cláusula de tiempo.

questions.question: I will call you when I ____ at the hotel. (Llegue).
questions.explanation: Después de 'when' usamos Presente Simple para futuro: when I arrive.

questions.question: As soon as we ____ the email, we will review it. (Recibamos).
questions.explanation: Después de 'as soon as' usamos Presente Simple: as soon as we receive.

questions.question: When the meeting ____, I will send you the notes. (Termine).
We will ship the order as soon as you ____. (Pagues).
When the CEO ____, everyone will stand up. (Llegue).
I will let you know when the client ____. (Llame).
As soon as I ____ the information, I will forward it to you. (Tenga).
What will you do when you ____ the project? (Termines).
We will start the meeting when everyone ____ here. (Esté).
As soon as she ____, we will begin. (Vuelva).
They will sign the contract when they ____ ready. (Estén).
I will check the figures when I ____ back to my desk. (Vuelva).
____ as I receive the document, I will print it. (Tan pronto como).
questions.explanation: As soon as = tan pronto como.

questions.question: We won't leave until the manager ____ it. (Apruebe).
questions.explanation: Al igual que when, 'until' lleva presente simple: until he approves.

questions.question: When you ____ the button, the machine will start. (Presiones).
I will send the agenda as soon as it ____ ready. (Esté).
questions.explanation: As soon as it is ready.

questions.question: We will talk about the budget when he ____ the team. (Se una).
As soon as the software ____, we will test it. (Se instale - is installed).
Will you call me when you ____ the result? (Sepas).
I will prepare the presentation when I ____ time. (Tenga).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo correcto en Presente Simple para la cláusula de tiempo.

questions.question: I will call you when I ____. (arrive)
As soon as we ____ the email, we will reply. (receive)
When the meeting ____, I will go. (finish)
We will ship it as soon as you ____. (pay)
When the CEO ____, please stand up. (arrive)
I will let you know when he ____. (call)
As soon as I ____ the info, I will send it. (have)
We will start when everyone ____ here. (be)
As soon as she ____, we will begin. (return)
I will check it when I ____ back. (get)

pairs.source: As soon as we receive it

pairs.target: Te avisaré / Te lo haré saber
